confounds.px4_version: PX4 v1.16.1 SITL in the AirStack simulator; tier 2 flies a port of PX4 v1.14.0's cascade (models/px4_cascade.py). Not removable here: named.
confounds.route: the speed-only MAVROS route: 35 of 35 steps sent velocity (and yaw rate) only (type mask 1479). Tier 2 emulates it with its two position gains at 0; the real drone's trajectory-setpoint route (position + velocity + acceleration) is not part of this comparison.

clock.text: the simulator's PX4 clock against the commander's wall clock, per step (fitted); removed by replaying the setpoint PX4 received on PX4's clock. Its size at the policy's level: the settled setpoint PX4 got over the teleop command, per speed.

confounds.estimator_source: the simulator's EKF2 fuses simulated GPS (EKF2_GPS_CTRL 7, EKF2_HGT_REF 1, EKF2_EV_CTRL 0); the drone fuses mocap. The error arm's values (T63) are the real drone_2's EKF2 against mocap, not this EKF2's error.
confounds.plant: not matched by tier 2: THR_MDL_FAC 0.8999999761581421 (tier 2 linear), the hover-thrust estimator (MPC_USE_HTE 1), Pegasus's input scaling 1350 against omega_max 1450, the USD's inertia (not read; v1's values used), PhysX scene and solver settings of each simulator.

params.label: SIM-ONLY: AirStack simulator values for the STE L1.5 comparison only (R21, 24 Nov 2026); never a training set, a drone value or an AirStack change

observed: observed in the training simulator (tier 2) against the AirStack simulator; not a flight result
